title: Making R62D its own program (+ updates, Play/Host/Join)

steps.name: Plan and token estimate
steps.about: Work out the steps and how many tokens the whole job takes.
steps.detail: About 3–5 million tokens in all (mostly re-reading), ~150k written

steps.name: Get the Windows program shell
steps.about: Download Electron for Windows: a ready-made program window with a web engine inside, so the game runs the same as in the browser.
steps.detail: Electron 45.2.2 for Windows downloaded, checksum matches

steps.name: Game server inside the program
steps.about: The program carries the game server, so whoever opens it can host.
steps.detail: Server starts inside the program when you click HOST

steps.name: Host or Join screen
steps.about: First screen: HOST to start a game on this computer, or type a friend's address and JOIN.
steps.detail: HOST / JOIN screen with recent addresses written

steps.name: Full screen window and keys
steps.about: Opens full screen, F11 switches to a window, Quit to desktop closes it.
steps.detail: Full screen, F11, Quit closes the program

steps.name: Saved profiles in the friend's own folder
steps.about: Each friend's profiles and settings are kept on their own computer.
steps.detail: Saved in %APPDATA%\R62D\data on each friend's PC

steps.name: Name and icon
steps.about: R62D.exe with its own icon.

steps.name: Build R62D.zip
steps.about: Put it all together into one file to download.

steps.name: Test it like a Windows PC would
steps.about: Run the .exe under Wine (Windows emulation) and check host, join and a match.
steps.detail: In Wine: start screen, HOST, the game menus and a free-play match all work; Quit closes it

steps.name: Browser version still works
steps.about: Run the usual game tests so nothing broke in the browser version.
steps.detail: Bot match on Harbor Office and free play test both PASS

steps.name: Download link on GitHub
steps.about: Upload R62D.zip to your GitHub Releases page for your friends.

steps.name: Update check when R62D opens
steps.about: Looks on your GitHub page for a newer release each time it starts.
steps.detail: Starter checks GitHub each time it opens (6 s at most, then plays what it has)

steps.name: Download and swap in the new game
steps.about: Fetches only the game files (small), checks them, keeps the old copy if anything fails.
steps.detail: Downloads only the game files, checks them, falls back to the old copy if anything fails

steps.name: Release script
steps.about: One command builds the program and the update and puts both on GitHub.
steps.detail: desktop/release.sh builds and publishes a release in one go

steps.name: Test an update in Wine
steps.about: Open an old copy, see it update itself to the newest.
steps.detail: In Wine: build 1 updated itself to build 237, hosted on it, and started fine with no internet

steps.name: PLAY: a game just for you
steps.about: Starts the game on your own computer only, with bots.
steps.detail: PLAY runs the game for this computer only

steps.name: HOST: open to home network and homelab
steps.about: Lets people on your home network or Lando's homelab VPN join.
steps.detail: HOST opens it to the network; other copies can find it

steps.name: JOIN: find games by itself
steps.about: Lando's homelab first, then games on your network; a short list if there are several.
steps.detail: JOIN checks Lando's homelab first, then asks the network; list if more than one

steps.name: Test it all in Wine
steps.about: Play, host, and join from a second copy.
steps.detail: Wine: PLAY stays on this computer, HOST opens it, JOIN finds the homelab and joins, 'no games' after 1.5 s

steps.name: New download link
steps.about: Publish the new version to GitHub.
